name: A Stray Line
storyline:
Your name is Taoyi Feng. The universe itself seems to have forgotten you.

You wake up to discover that your home, your belongings, and even the surrounding woodlands have been changed beyond recognition. People no longer remember your face, or the misfortune you caused your loved ones. There are holes in the floor, but you can't see through them.

Perhaps something out there has granted you a clean slate. This time, you will make yourself worth forgiving.
summary: A STRAY LINE is a point and click Adventure Game with a spoonful of autumnal love and body horror. Explore a strange world, draw to cast spells, and discover what becomes of a lonely little family in the woods.
